headline: Phone Calls With Brain Fog: Five Lines for When You Lose the Thread
sub: Put these at the bottom of your page.
items: You lost the thread: Sorry, I lost my place. Can you repeat the last part?
They're going too fast: Could you slow down? I'm writing this down.
You want it in writing: Can you send that to me in writing, so I can go through it after we hang up?
Asked the same thing again: I gave those details to your colleague. Can you see the notes on the account?
You need to stop: I need to stop here. Can I call back, and who should I ask for?

headline: After an Adult ADHD Diagnosis: The First Month of Admin, in Order
sub: Nothing here is a deadline set by anyone. It's an order that keeps the costly steps early.
items: Before you leave the visit: Ask how follow-ups and refills work, and when the next visit is.
The same day: Put the next appointment in your calendar with the time you have to leave, not just the time it starts.
Within a week: Fill in the one page below.
Within two weeks: Ask your insurer how visits and prescriptions are covered.
Within a month: Decide who you want to tell, and how.
